What does the progress measure?

The percentage follows actual received response bytes, never a timer. HTTP compression can make the network transfer smaller than the original studio size shown here. If a host adds extra tail data, the remaining transfer is indeterminate; only the exact SHA-256-verified original studio is opened, without those additions. Verification and application startup have no invented percentage.
